property_summary: For any owner call to Command sending any amount with any payload to a counterparty whose payable fallback performs more than the 2300-gas stipend of work (e.g. a storage write), the reference's unchecked low-level call makes Command succeed, whereas the mutant's bare transfer fails the stipend so Command reverts.
change_summary: Replace the low-level call with a transfer of msg.value to adr, discarding the calldata payload.
